6351-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-5663-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-2557-4094-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2653-2893-6664-7886.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Beorn's Hospitality trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2021-2060-6627-7061.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

372-1567-1621.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1567-1621.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

792-2946-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
792-2946-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-4050-5789-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-5789-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-5921-5970-7297.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2906-5639-7070.notablePrerequisites:
Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
You have one or fewer cards in hand.
2906-5639-7070.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Arm-Mounted Anchor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

2034-2279-4365-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2279-4365-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3480-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-3480-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

290-2645-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Dreamstone Hedron's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
290-2645-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

1789-4452-5147-5649.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-4452-5147-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

719-3129-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4050-5220-5683.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4050-5220-5683.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using one colored mana, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for the creature and putting it into your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3277-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Izzet Chronarch each turn.
3277-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chronarch by paying its mana cost.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Izzet Chronarch from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-586-2438-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1479-4493-5233.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a token copy of Kodama of the East Tree that isn't legendary.
Play Boros Garrison.
Kodama of the East Tree, the Kodama of the East Tree token, and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
The Kodama of the East Tree token and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kodama of the East Tree with haste.
Play Boros Garrison.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1017-1656-2335-3408.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
1017-1656-2335-3408.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Necrotic Ooze using Talas Researcher's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

3247-3327-4740-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3247-3327-4740-4871.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Razaketh by paying two life and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Razaketh ability, causing you to search your library for a card and put it into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to any target.
Repeat step 9 as many times as desired.

769-1722-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
769-1722-2034.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Mentor of the Meek.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mentor of the Meek trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

7-539-2232-3396-4488.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter among creatures you control.
7-539-2232-3396-4488.description:
Cast Quirion Sentinel for {G}, triggering Rampaging Baloths and Cloudstone Curio.
Quirion Sentinel triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger choosing not to return another permanent.
Resolve Rampaging Baloths's trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast token triggers Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger returning Quirion Sentinel to your hand.
Repeat.

337-776-1329-3092.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-3092.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Orochi Hatchery to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Orochi Hatchery.
Cast Orochi Hatchery.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

595-2452-2577.description:
Activate Nantuko Husk's ability by sacrificing Gravecrawler, Nantuko gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
